subject: Need to move the call
text: The call this afternoon? I need move it, sorry, something just landed and I won’t have any quiet place to talk until maybe later, or tomorrow. I thought the client issue was over but it’s not, they just emailed with another change and now I have to sort the files before I can be useful on our call. Could we try Thursday afternoon? If not, Friday morning might work better, though my train is uncertain. I’m sorry for the chaos and for sending this so late. Please ignore my first message if you already saw it; I started typing twice. I’ll send a new invite only if this day suits you. Thanks anyway
